親愛的教職員生：

適逢端午連假，K書中心A館於114/5/30(五)~114/6/1(日)
休館三日

K書中心B館維持24小時開放使用
敬請遵守使用規範

教學卓越中心 敬啟
--------------------------------------------------------
Dear Faculty, Staff, and Students,

Due to the Dragon Boat Festival holiday, Study Center A will be closed for three days from May 30, 2025 (Friday) to June 1, 2025 (Sunday).

K Study Center Building B will remain open 24 hours as usual.
Please adhere to the usage regulations.

Best regards,

Center for Teaching Excellence
